programs.title: The Expatriate
programs.desc: An ex-CIA agent has to go on the run with his estranged daughter when his new employers erase all evidence of his existence. Starring Aaron Eckhart (2012).

programs.title: Acts of Violence
programs.desc: (2018) Action-packed abduction thriller with Bruce Willis. When his fiancée is kidnapped by sex traffickers, a former US Army Ranger and his brothers join forces with a veteran detective to find her.

programs.title: Triple Cross
programs.desc: (1967) WWII spy thriller with Christopher Plummer. Loosely based on a true story, bank robber Eddie Chapman gets entangled in spying for both sides during World War Two, becoming a triple agent.

programs.title: Panhandle
programs.desc: (1948) Western starring Rod Cameron. A former Texas marshal is determined to prove a powerful casino owner is behind his brother's murder.
